briefings.title: Roadster Event
briefings.tldr: Tesla unveiled the new SpaceX-collaboration Roadster, a high-performance rocket-thruster vehicle capable of unprecedented stunts like short flights and a 0-60 mph time of 0.81 seconds, slated for production in 2028.

briefings.title: Elon Musk: What Comes Next for Humanity
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk appeared at the X Takeover event at Giga Texas to discuss Tesla's near-death experiences, Starship’s rapid recovery milestones, AI abundance, humanoid robotics challenges with Optimus, and building in-house chip research fabs.

briefings.title: Full: Exclusive CMG interview with Tesla CEO Elon Musk
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk discusses China’s manufacturing excellence and infrastructure, rapid AI breakthroughs, the commercialization of Tesla's Cybercab and Optimus robots, and his long-term vision for a multiplanetary, AI-abundant future.

briefings.title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger
briefings.tldr: Gwynne Shotwell and Elon Musk detailed massive infrastructure expansions across SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI—highlighting plans for Mars within the decade, space-based compute data centers, and a chip fabrication facility ("Terafab")—while proposing cross-company and international AI peer-review test harnesses to mitigate existential risks.

briefings.title: The full-length interview with Elon Musk | The Economist
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts that artificial intelligence will exceed total human intelligence in approximately five years and usher in an age of physical and digital abundance via humanoid robotics within a decade.

briefings.title: Elon Musk on AI: humans will no longer be in control in ten years  | The Economist
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts that artificial intelligence will exceed total human intelligence in approximately five years and leave humans out of control within a decade, steering humanity toward an inevitable "age of amazing abundance."

briefings.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Financial Results and Q&A Webcast
briefings.tldr: Tesla reported record Q2 2026 vehicle deliveries and a massive 53% sequential increase in energy storage deployments (13.5 GWh), driven by surging demand for Full Self-Driving (FSD) and energy infrastructure, even as capital expenditures doubled to over $25 billion annualized and operating expenses rose due to R&D for Robotaxi, Optimus, and AI chips.

briefings.title: BREAKING NEWS: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani Calls Out Elon Musk, ICE During July 4 Address
briefings.tldr: In his July 4th address marking America's 250th anniversary, NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani contrasted the nation's founding ideals of freedom and asylum with contemporary inequalities, corporate monopolies, and immigration enforcement, urging citizens to pursue a more inclusive democracy through active dissent and community solidarity.

briefings.title: Kara Swisher Calls Out Elon Musk and Big Tech’s “Petty, Angry" People | Pivot
briefings.channel: Pivot with Kara Swisher and Scott Galloway
briefings.tldr: This briefing covers the passing of media visionary Ted Turner, a mixed earnings week for legacy media giants Disney, Paramount, and Warner Bros. Discovery, and the escalating "petty" legal and corporate drama between Elon Musk and OpenAI.

briefings.title: Musk vs Altlman & Taylor Swift Trademarks | Bloomberg Law
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk is seeking to unwind OpenAI's for-profit conversion in a high-stakes trial alleging the "theft" of a non-profit charity, while Taylor Swift is pioneering a novel legal strategy using trademark law to combat AI deepfakes.

briefings.title: Musk vs Altman: ‘This isn’t going the way Elon Musk wanted’ | Will Guyatt
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk’s lawsuit against OpenAI is facing significant hurdles as recent testimony reveals his own past intentions to commercialize the entity, undermining his legal argument that the company must remain a non-profit.

briefings.title: Ross Gerber on Elon Musk & Tesla’s 16% Revenue Growth, Google Cloud Next Conference, AI Insurance
briefings.tldr: Tesla faces scrutiny over narrow profitability and CEO Elon Musk's overextension, while the broader AI sector grapples with an "implementation gap" as corporations struggle to integrate agents and insurers move to exclude AI-related liabilities.

briefings.title: The billionaires' utopia blueprint | Throughline
briefings.tldr: Modern tech billionaires are attempting to bypass traditional nation-state governance by creating "startup nations" and private jurisdictions, evolving from historical precedents like Svalbard to modern experiments like Próspera.

briefings.title: Tesla Q1 2026 Financial Results and Q&A Webcast
briefings.tldr: Tesla is pivoting into a massive $25B+ capital investment phase for 2026, prioritizing the "revolutionary" scale-up of Optimus, AI-5 chip architecture, and unsupervised Full Self-Driving (FSD) over short-term free cash flow.

briefings.title: Elon Musk vs. Sam Altman, AI Job Loss, and OpenAI’s $852B Valuation | EP #247
briefings.tldr: The AI industry is entering a "geopolitical and governance war" phase, characterized by the Musk vs. Altman $100B lawsuit, massive capital redirection toward Anthropic, and the rapid migration of AI intelligence into physical robotics and biological drug discovery.

briefings.title: Ex-Tesla President: Elon Behind-The-Scenes, Saving Tesla & Scaling a Trillion-Dollar Company
briefings.tldr: Former Tesla President Jon McNeill reveals "The Algorithm"—a management framework centered on setting 10X "order of magnitude" goals, identifying market friction through frontline observation, and radical simplification of complex business models.

briefings.title: How Elon Achieves the Impossible - Eric Jorgenson
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk’s unprecedented success is driven by a combination of "maniacal urgency," first-principles thinking, and a profound risk tolerance fueled by a sense of existential purpose.

briefings.title: How Saudi Arabia shaped Silicon Valley | Throughline
briefings.tldr: Under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS), Saudi Arabia has leveraged its massive sovereign wealth to transition from a passive oil state into a dominant architect of Silicon Valley, using billions in capital to secure influence over the future of AI, social media, and global surveillance infrastructure.

briefings.title: Elon Reveals TERAFAB (Tesla & SpaceX) - Full Replay - Becoming a galactic civilization
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk announced "Terafab," a massive joint venture between Tesla, SpaceX, and xAI to build one terawatt of annual AI compute.

briefings.title: Elon Musk: Optimus 3 Is Coming, Recursive Self-Improvement Is Already Here, and the Singularity #239
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts a "hard takeoff" for AI with full recursive self-improvement by 2025, leading to a 10x expansion of the global economy within a decade and an eventual post-scarcity era of "Universal High Income."

briefings.title: Elon Musk – "In 36 months, the cheapest place to put AI will be space”
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts that within 36 months, space will become the most economical location for AI data centers due to Earth's power constraints and regulatory hurdles, enabling an unprecedented scale of AI compute, which will in turn drive advancements in humanoid robotics and address critical global challenges like national debt.

briefings.title: Tesla and Waymo execs testify before Senate panel on the future of self-driving cars — 2/4/26
briefings.tldr: The Senate hearing underscored a bipartisan consensus for a federal framework for autonomous vehicles (AVs) to enhance safety, promote American innovation, and secure jobs, while addressing critical concerns around federal oversight, data privacy, liability, and ensuring equitable access and workforce protection.

briefings.title: Tesla Q4 and full year 2025 Financial Results and QA Webcast
briefings.tldr: Tesla is fundamentally redefining its mission to "Amazing Abundance" and "Universal High Income," pivoting aggressively towards an autonomous future driven by AI and robotics.
